_note: Copy to config/animkit.json (git-ignored, one per checkout) or run `python tools/setup_config.py`, which detects fonts and ffmpeg. Paths are absolute paths on YOUR machine. math_python: a python that has matplotlib; null = the interpreter running the render. ffmpeg: null = PATH / conda env / imageio-ffmpeg. Optional: text_<code> / bold_<code> fonts for a translated render (--lang <code>) in a script the Latin fonts lack.

fonts.text: <Latin regular, default for labels and captions: segoeui.ttf, Arial.ttf, DejaVuSans.ttf>
fonts.bold: <Latin bold, titles and headers: segoeuib.ttf, Arial Bold.ttf, DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf>
fonts.light: <Latin light face for years, numbers, small labels: segoeuil.ttf, DejaVuSans-ExtraLight.ttf>
fonts.math: <serif italic for symbols drawn as text: cambriai.ttf, DejaVuSerif-Italic.ttf>
